analysis.scoreReason: RSI 과매도 구간 진입, MACD 악화 지속
analysis.reason: RSI 37.5로 과매도 구간 진입, 5일 전 21.1에서 회복 시도. MACD 히스토그램 -0.6757로 개선 중이나 여전히 음수. 주봉 RSI 35.3으로 약세 구간. ADX 47.9로 추세 강하나 -DI 41.3이 +DI 17.1보다 우위. 52주 저가 $124.50 대비 현재가 $149.30은 20.9% 위치. 5일 평균 거래량 대비 0.73으로 위축된 거래량은 하락 추세 속 반등의 신뢰도를 낮춤. 20일 저가 $124.50 대비 5일 저가 $124.50은 동일하여 Higher Low 패턴 미형성. 5일 고가 $171.50은 20일 고가 $215.33보다 낮아 Lower High 패턴 가능성. ATR 8.96%로 변동성 고려 시 손절폭 1.0~4.0배 설정 필요. 스윙 지지선 $140.85, 저항선 $153.13.
analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 37.5, attempting to recover from oversold territory (vs. 21.1 five days ago). MACD histogram improving to -0.6757 but still negative. Weekly RSI at 35.3, indicating weakness. ADX at 47.9 shows strong trend, but -DI (41.3) is stronger than +DI (17.1). Current price at $149.30 is 20.9% above 52-week low of $124.50. Volume ratio of 0.73 (below 5-day average) suggests weak conviction in any bounce within the downtrend. 5-day low matches 20-day low, failing to form a Higher Low. 5-day high is lower than 20-day high, suggesting a potential Lower High. ATR at 8.96% implies stop loss range of 1.0-4.0x ATR. Key support at $140.85, resistance at $153.13.
analysis.weeklyConflict: 주봉 ADX 25.1로 뚜렷한 추세이나, 일봉 ADX 47.9는 과열 구간 경계. 주봉 RSI 35.3, 일봉 RSI 37.5로 약세 구간 유지.
analysis.weeklyConflictEn: Weekly ADX at 25.1 indicates a clear trend, but daily ADX at 47.9 is near overbought territory. Both weekly (35.3) and daily (37.5) RSI remain in weak territory.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($149.30) above SMA5 ($148.25) but below SMA20 ($172.48): attempting short-term bounce, below mid-term trend.
· Significantly below SMA100 ($208.51) / SMA200 ($202.62): long-term trend is weak.
· 52-week position (20.9%): consolidating near the low.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (21.1 → 37.5): attempting to exit oversold, preparing to enter neutral zone.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-3.8265 → -0.6757): improving, but weakness persists.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $125.96): approaching lower band, band width is wide at 53.94%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($140.85): above Pivot S1 ($110.76).
· Swing resistance ($153.13): potential for stronger short-term bounce if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low not formed, potential Lower High): signal of weakening trend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.73): low conviction in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (attempting bounce within downtrend): consider buying after confirmation of support at $140.85, observe for breakout above resistance at $153.13.
